results.query: Quy tac retry POST payment la gi?
results.retrieved:
EPISODE: For POST /payments, every retryable request MUST send the same Idempotency-Key. Retry only HTTP 429 or transient 5xx errors, use exponential-backoff, and stop after max-3-retries. Marker: PAYMENT-RULE-3.
ENTITY: POST /payments - POST /payments requires requests to send the same Idempotency-Key for every retryable request. Retries should only occur for HTTP 429 or transient 5xx errors, using exponential backoff, and stopping after a maximum of three retries. This is designated by Marker PAYMENT-RULE-3.
ENTITY: Payment API Retry Policy - For POST /payments, every retryable request must send the same Idempotency-Key. Retry only HTTP 429 or transient 5xx errors using exponential-backoff, and stop after max-3-retries. This is Marker: PAYMENT-RULE-3.
ENTITY: max-3-retries - For POST /payments, every retryable request must send the same Idempotency-Key. Requests should retry only HTTP 429 or transient 5xx errors using exponential-backoff and stop after max-3-retries, as per PAYMENT-RULE-3.
